posts.text: 🇧🇷 🇺🇦 Brazilian Muay Thai champion killed fighting alongside Ukrainian forces Gustavo Ferro, a 31-year-old Brazilian and three-time Muay Thai champion who travelled to Ukraine to fight alongside the Ukrainian Armed Forces, has reportedly been killed. According to reports citing his relatives, Ferro died on November 26 alongside the rest of his unit following a drone strike. He had arrived in Ukraine in August and was already wounded by shrapnel during a drone attack in September. Despite his earlier injuries, he subsequently returned to the front line. His family is now reportedly facing difficulties in securing the return of his remains to Brazil, with relatives expressing concerns about the Ukrainian military command’s willingness to facilitate the repatriation. Another foreign mercenary whose journey to Ukraine ended in death. 🔴 @DDGeopolitics

It’s absurd how sacred titles are being turned into cheap runway shows and makeup parades. Shrines aren’t graduation halls, and throwing money at flashy mixed events and clout-chasing photographers instead of actually helping the community is a total joke. Just like wasted Hajj funds, this is pure vanity disguised as devotion. True connection is about values and modesty, not empty slogans and cheap clout. True "Daughters of Al-Zahra" live by her modesty and values, not pointless luxury parades that just waste Islamic funds. Enough is enough.
